title: console Settings pages fetch /api/settings with no session locale, so server-composed copy (the Localization page's currency-lock banner, write refusals, action copy) comes back in the browser's language on a zh-CN session
body:
qa#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibzj9DrVWXkq7joYHGB

Kind: product defect (off-clause probe, rule 8) — severity guess P2 (mixed-language page on a switched session; no data effect)

## Repro (main a557fa386bc3, stock showcase)
1. Boot: `pnpm -C examples/app-showcase exec objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin --no-compile --no-watch -p PORT -d file:/tmp/x.db`.
2. In a browser whose own language is English (Accept-Language en-US), sign in at http://localhost:PORT/_console/ as admin@objectos.ai / admin123.
3. Avatar menu → Language → 中文 (writes sys_user.locale; the shell turns Chinese).
4. Open Setup → 设置 → 本地化 (`/_console/apps/setup/system/settings/localization`).
- Expected: the info banner at the top reads `默认币种已锁定：USD` with its zh-CN text (the zh-CN entry of CURRENCY_LOCK_COPY, lockedLabel / lockedText).
- Actual: the banner reads `Default currency locked: USD` / `In use by 1 object (Invoice) and 4 exchange rates. Converted amounts are stored in this currency, so it can no longer be changed.`, while every other string on the page (title 本地化, groups 区域 / 财务, key labels 默认时区, source badges) is Chinese.
- Network: the page's `GET /api/settings/localization` carries `accept-language: en-US` (the browser default), while the same page's `GET /api/v1/meta/object` carries `accept-language: zh-Hans`.
- Server control: `curl -H 'Accept-Language: zh-CN' /api/settings/localization` and `-H 'Accept-Language: zh-Hans'` both answer `默认币种已锁定：USD` — the server copy and its locale pick are correct.

## Mechanism
- `ui/apps/console/src/pages/settings/api.ts:102` `jsonHeaders()` sends only `Content-Type` and `Accept`; `getSettingsNamespace` / `listSettingsManifests` / the PUT and action POSTs (lines 137-184) use it with raw `fetch`, so no session locale reaches the server and the browser's own Accept-Language is what arrives.
- `packages/services/service-settings/src/settings-routes.ts:216-222` `requestLocaleOf` reads the top Accept-Language tag, else `?locale` — so it picks the browser's language, and `liveStatementOf` (line 316), `getNamespace` (304) and the action route (385) hand that to `currencyLockCopy()` (`packages/services/service-settings/src/localization-currency-lock.ts:330`) and the other per-request copy tables (`settings-action-copy.ts`, `localization-locale-options.ts` NOT_OFFERED_COPY).
- The console's own metadata client sends the session language (zh-Hans), which is why the rest of the page is Chinese.
- Not new in 18.5: neither file changed since 18.4.0 (`git log 181ad7d4..HEAD` empty for both).

## Fix direction
Send the session language from the settings API client (the same header the metadata client sends), or pass `?locale=`.

## Duplicates searched (open issues, objectstack-ai/objectstack)
- `settings Accept-Language` → 3 hits, all PM seat cards (#12708, #6023, #6015)
- `currency lock locale` → 7 hits, none about this (#32984 AI build chat, #31908 audit ADR, PM seats)
- `settings page locale english banner` → 4 hits, PM seats only
- `live status locale settings` → 11 hits, none about this (#33358, #25921, #31908, PM seats)
